dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are distributed across the dorsal surface. The most prominent exhibit crenulated, high-contrast margins with a sharp gradient transition from light perimeter pixels to darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of bright pixel clusters concentrated in the lateral-mid regions. These clusters form the framework of the ring patterns, showing solid intensity in narrow segments that lack internal shading.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular scalene triangle in the upper-mid body, with a secondary chain of smaller structures forming a series of obtuse-angled relationships extending toward the lower-left lateral margin.
